timeline.summary: Maithan Alloys reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹559.18 Cr and a pre-tax loss of ₹72.32 Cr.

Maithan Alloys Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Rajesh K. Shah, declared an interim dividend of ₹11 per equity share on May 16, 2026, payable after May 29, 2026, with a record date of May 28, 2026.
DRI Visakhapatnam conducted a search and seizure under the Customs Act at Maithan Alloys' Visakhapatnam plant on October 9–10, 2026, with no disruption to operations.
Maithan Alloys completed acquisition of 0.05% stake in HFCL Limited for ₹20 Cr on October 13, 2026
Completed on-market acquisition of 0.04% stake (2.28 lakh shares) in Sterlite Technologies for ₹19.97 Cr on October 16, 2026.
Incorporated 80%-owned subsidiary M&M Water Solutions Private Limited with ₹4 Cr equity investment for water treatment EPC.
Acquired an additional 0.09% stake in Sterlite Technologies Limited for ₹38.72 crore on October 19, 2026.
